flags.why: Nghĩa trang is an ordinary word used in everyday speech, so the formal tag is misleading.
The sense meaning desolate or cheerless is also used in everyday speech and is not restricted to literary language.
Vắng chủ means the owner is absent, not that the house has been abandoned.
flags.fix: The house looks desolate and forlorn with its owner away.

flags.why: Dĩa meaning a disc or record remains current in Southern Vietnamese.
Vận meaning to wear clothes is literary rather than an ordinary casual verb.
Learners are more likely to encounter vận meaning luck or fortune than its literary clothing sense.
